messages:
Alex: stepping on for the night shift — quick snapshot: no SEV open, latency SLOs green overall but saw a small regen latency bump in eu-west1 around 03:30 UTC.
Maria: saw that spike, started a short autoscaler tweak in staging (PR #452). should reduce preempt churn for regen workers.
Sam: can you drop the PR link here? I want to skim the config change.
Maria: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/452 — changes the minReplicas/kafkaBatch window, was careful to keep burst headroom.
Jamie: FYI I noticed a handful of 504s correlated with a model-variant rollout earlier. I opened logs and a quick filter:
```
grep "504" /var/log/regen/eu-west1/* | head
# trace id: a1b2c3 — model-variant: v2-quant
```
Jamie: I rolled the canary back to v2-quant-stable at 03:56 UTC which stopped the 504s.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0337 created: regen-eu-west1-504s — status: resolved — mitigation: rollback model variant.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollback v2-quant -> v2-quant-stable applied (deployer=jessica) — logs: https://deploys.internal/rollbacks/789
Lee: thanks for the quick rollback. I'll run a slow canary tomorrow morning with tighter observability.
Alex: blockers: need approval on the dedicated-capacity bump ticket (#1248) before we schedule the eu-west1 canary on dedicated pool.
Maria: pinged infra lead for approval, should have it within the next 2 hours. also added a small metric for kvcache prewarm hit-rate.
Sam: no blockers from my side. I'll keep an eye on SLO dashboards and the regen queue depth.
Jamie: action for me: follow up on the post-rollback traces and add a short note to the incident doc. leaving a placeholder in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/INC-2026-0337
Alex: next steps: 1) monitor autoscaler impact from PR #452 in staging, 2) wait for capacity-approval on #1248, 3) Jamie to finish incident notes, 4) Lee to run canary ramp tomorrow with tighter thresholds.
Maria: small reminder — label any rapid reverts with `rollback` and add the original deploy id in PR description.
Sam: I'll run a quick synthetic test against eu-west1 regen path every 10m for the next 4 hours. will post results here if anything spikes.
Alex: handoff: I'll be available via DM until 14:00 PST, then Jamie takes over. ping me if the autoscaler shows oscillation.
Jamie: ack, taking over at 14:00 PST. thanks all.
Lee: leaving one follow-up item — confirm kvcache TTL edit didn't regress memory usage; I'll open a tiny perf PR if needed.
Maria: opened a short changelog in the infra repo and added a note to the runbook under "regen rollbacks".
Alex: ok closing out this thread — summary in one line: rollback applied, autoscaler tweak in staging, watch autoscaler + kvcache, awaiting capacity approval (#1248). :thumbsup:
